name: stt-assignment
description: Real-time multilingual speech-to-text with transcript history (Sarvam saaras:v4 + Postgres)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.stt-local: docker build -t stt-local ./stt-local && docker run --rm --name stt-local -p 8001:8000 stt-local
